signal: Funnel raised $32M to expand sales and marketing, completed its front-office CRM suite, and is now the full-portfolio CRM for five of the 20 largest apartment owners in America.

email.body1:
Benjamin, saw Funnel raised $32M, completed its front-office suite, and is now CRM for five of the 20 largest apartment owners.

Growth like that usually means more in-market operators than a regional sales team can cover before interest cools, and that is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Funnel off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Benjamin, quick follow-up for Funnel.

Post-raise, the pipeline target for your region usually climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings your region needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Benjamin, last bit of proof for Funnel.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Funnel's reply rate likely compares to other multifamily-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Benjamin, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch after a raise is its own kind of busy, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your regional sales motion? I'll tailor it to Funnel either way.
